capabilities: arrange draggable, resizable widgets on a configurable grid with an edit mode
track note-editing activity as a heatmap with streaks and totals
aggregate open tasks from all notes and complete them inline
capture thoughts to an inbox file or today's daily note
embed notes, Bases, Dataview queries, and Mermaid diagrams on the dashboard
extras: Not yet on the Obsidian community plugin list; must be built from source or installed from a release, and the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in at-a-glance start page that combines daily notes, vault tasks, activity stats, and quick capture in one view.

relations.evidence: a .base, a Dataview query, a diagram, or markdown you type

summary: Dashboard plugin that shows a configurable grid of draggable widgets for calendar, tasks, activity heatmaps, capture, and link insights.
